import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {

    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"tcl\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("puts hello", config)
    println(result)
